title: Syntax Scoring
description: Score corrupted and incomplete bracket expressions using a stack-based parser.
writeup:
## Approach

A stack-based bracket matcher. Push opening brackets, pop and verify on closing brackets. The line's fate — corrupt or incomplete — determines which scoring system applies.

## Part 1

A line is **corrupted** if a closing bracket doesn't match the most recent open bracket. Score each first illegal character: `)` = 3, `]` = 57, `}` = 1197, `>` = 25137. Sum all corruption scores.

## Part 2

Non-corrupted lines are **incomplete** — the stack still has unmatched openers. The completion string closes them in reverse order. Score it by repeatedly multiplying the running total by 5 and adding the bracket's value (`)` = 1, `]` = 2, `}` = 3, `>` = 4). Take the median of all completion scores.
